topic: Hs-microbiome research (Hs / CN-TT applied to microbiome compositional data; reference framework coda4microbiome).
purpose: Local node for the microbiome application: results, capability, and the relationship to coda4microbiome.
paths_note: key_files relative to THIS folder; join_the_chain relative to the Hs repo root.

specific_knowledge.what: Microbiome data is compositional, high-dimensional and sparse -- the regime Hs's tiling was built for. We deal with the instrument, not the data: datasets and biological interpretation belong to coda4microbiome and the source studies; we do not store or redistribute them.
key_results: Tier 1: real Crohn data 975x48 reconstructed losslessly to 1.8e-14
Tier 1: ECAM infant-gut maturation recovered -- K_eff vs age Spearman rho=0.71, p=2.5e-6
Tier 1: honest Crohn diversity null -- CD vs control K_eff 7.31 vs 7.23, p=0.78 (auto-flagged DX-NUL-DIS)
Tier 1: high-D capability lossless to D=10,000 (~7ms/sample), proven to D=1,000,000 via the tree atlas
specific_knowledge.claim_tiers: Tier 1 = the computed results above; Tier 2 = the coda4microbiome complementarity framing; Tier 3 = any biological claim + the longitudinal head-to-head.

bring_your_own_ai: Start at README.md (executive summary + capability table), then results/. Data is NOT stored here -- see results/DATA_SOURCE.txt. Read-only context; governance + claim-tiers apply.
governance: HUF-STD-001; instrument not data (we read data where it lives, never redistribute); honest-broker (nulls reported); no AI commits.
